description: Twasomye icete canditswe na Yakobo 1:16-19. Twarumvise ibintu bimwe bimwe vyerekana umuntu yavyawe ubwa kabiri kubw'ijambo ry'Imana : gutanga n'umutima ubikunze, kwirinda kuraka, ivyo vyose n'ingendo ziranga umukristo w'ukuri. Twibukanije ivyanditse muri iki cete ca Yakobo 1 :19,havuga ngo : ivyo murabizi bene data nkunda, yamara umuntu wese niyihutire kwumva, atebe kuvuga, atebe kuraka, igikuru dukwiye kwihutira kwumva ni ijambo ry'Imana.Biboneka ko hari abakristo benshi bihutira gushinga intahe no kuvuga ijambo ry'Imana kandi batararimenya mbere bakiri bato mu kwizera . Nivyiza kwihutira kwiga no kunonosora ijambo ry'Imana imbere yo kuryigisha abandi. Bitayeko mu bugingo bw'umukristo hakwiye kwirinda akarimi karekare kandi hakihutirwa kwumva no kumenya ivy'Imana igomba. Ikintu twumvise umukristo ategerezwa kwirinda n'ugushavura. Twasomye ngo atebe kuraka, dutegerezwa kwirinda amajambo yose y'ibihari yotuma turaka naho kwoba ari uguharira kuvy'Imana.Izo mpanuro zose nizo kudufasha kwirinda ibidutandukanya n'Imana.
name: Abakristo bavyawe ukundi gusha

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivyerekeye gukora ico ijambo ry'Imana rivuga. Twarumvise ko ari ngombwa yuko dukora ivyo ijambo ry'Imana ritubwira nk'uko vyanditse mu cete ca Yakobo 1:22. Abatarakizwa bo ubutumwa bakwiye n'ubwo kwizera Umwami Yesu arikwo kwizera ijambo ry'Imana. Nayo ukwirukira gukora canke gushira mu ngiro ijambo ry'Imana ribasaba ntavyo baba barashobora, bakwiye gusa kubanza kwakira n'ukwizera Umwami Yesu. Twarabonye mu ceye ca Yakobo 1:23 na Yakobo 1:24 yuko hari akaga gakomeye mu kwirengagiza Ijambo ry'Imana ariko Yakobo 1:25 turabona ko ari umugisha ku bumva ijambo ry'Imana bakaryatondera.
name: Akaga kugufata minenerwe ijambo ry'Imana

description: Twumvise ivyiza biva mukwitegereza no gushishikara ivyagezwe vy'Imana, uwo vyitondera azohabwa umugisha muvyo akora. Twaraganiriye kandi kuvy'idini nyakuri. Icambere kiranga idini y'ukuri ngo ni ugufata ururimi, ni ugufasha impfuvyi n'abapfakazi mu mibabaro yabo. Ikindi gihambaye n'ukwirinda ngo ntitwanduzwe n'ivy'isi.ivyo vyose biri mumirongo yanyuma y'igice cambere c'icete canditswe na Yakobo.Twarangirije mu gice ca kabiri cico cete aho twumvise ivyo kwirinda kurobanura  abantu ku cubahiro.
name: Iivyo gushira mungiro ijambo ry'Imana

description: Ubuheruka, twarangije icete ca Yakobo , twumvise amajambo y'impanuro yerekeye ivyo kwihangana aho yerekanye ko ari ukwihangana gushika kw'iherezo. Ikindi twabonye n'ubushobozi bwo gusenga. Yakobo yavuze ngo: Ugusaba kw'Umugororotsi kugira ikimazi kuri vyinshi mu gikorwa cakwo (Yakobo 5:16).
name: Impanuro y' ukwihangana

description: Ubuheruka twaganiriye ivy'ugufata ururimi. Twongera turabira hamwe mu ncamake itandukaniro ry'ubwenge bwo mw'isi n'ubwo mw'ijuru.Twibukanije ko ururimi rushobora guturira igisagara canke rugaturira igihugu cose iyo rukoreshejwe nabi. Umukristo w'ukuri yirinda kuvuga vuga, akitwararika kwumva ijambo ry'Imana no kurinonosora. Ikindi twokwibukanya nuko ubwenge bwo mw'isi burangwa n'ubwibone n'izindi ngeso mbi ariko ubwenge bwo mw'ijuru bukarangwa no kugororoka n'amahoro biva ku Mana ( Yakobo 3:17)
name: Ingene ururimi rutwanduza

description: Twumvise ijambo ry'intangamarara rijanye n'icete canditswe na Yakobo duca turihweza ivyanditswe mu mirongo itatu ya mbere y'igice ca mbere.Twabonye ko Yakobo yanditse ico cete acerekeje ku b'Isirayeli basabagiye mu mahanga yose kugira ngo abaremeshereze mw'ijambo ry'Imana. Twashimikiye kw'ijambo ryo kwihanganira amageragezwa kukaba nkako Imana irazi ivyo ducamwo vyose n'igituma biba bishitse.Twarabonye ko hari aho Imana ibireka kugira ngo bitwigishe ukwihangana kandi ngo bitugirire akamaro muri kazoza kacu(Yakobo 1:3)
name: Intangamarara y'igitabo

description: Twarabiye hamwe ukuntu Isirayeli yirukiye Egiputa na Ashuri irondera imfashanyo ariko ntayo yaronse.
name: Isirayeli ihindukirira Egiputa na Ashuri ngo bibakize

description: Twarabiye hamwe ingene ukwizera kutagira ibikorwa ataco kuba kumaze. Yakobo we yavuze ngo: Ukwizera kutagira ibikorwa kuba gupfuye ngo kandi nkuko umubiri utarimwo impwemu uba upfuye niko n'ukwizera kutagira ibikorwa kumera( Yakobo 2:26).Ukwizera guhingugwa n'ibikorwa kandi ibikorwa vyakwo nivyo bidutsindanishiriza .
name: Ivy'ukwizera n'ibikorwa  vyakwo

description: Twaganiriye ku vyo kwihanganira ibitugerageza, ibitugerageza bidutera kwihanagana nakwo ku kaba ari icamwa ca mpwemu year. Twarumvise ko ibitugerageza atari bibi, kuko ngo umuntu avyihanganira gushika kwiherezo, azohabwa igitsibo c'ubugingo ico Imana yasezeraniye abayikunda. Twarumvise ko amageragezwa ari uburyo bubiri. Hari amageragezwa y'ingorane ariyo mibabaro abantu bacamo kandi bagashobora kuyigishirizwamwo ukwihangana bakarushirizaho kwegera Imana . hari n'amageragezwa y inyosha mbi z' umurwanizi yosha abantu gukora ibibi.Imana rero siyo igerageresha abantu gukora ibibi nkuko Yakobo abivuga (Yakobo1:13).
name: Ivyiza biva mu kwihangana

description: Tumaze iminsi tuganira kuvyerekeye amageragezwa ashikira abantu b'Imana. Tukiri muri iy'isi amageragezwa ntazoreka kudushikako ariko ni ahacu kuyihanganira. Twibukanye yuko hari amageragezwa y'uburyo bubiri, ubwa mbere hari amageragezwa y'ingorane canke amarushwa umuntu acamwo muri ayo mageragezwa umukristo ntakwiye kwihebura canke ngo arogote ku Mana kuko ntiba imwanse iba imubona (Yakobo 1:3) . Ubwa kabiri hari amageragezwa y'inyosha mbi mu mutima kugira ngo umuntu akore icaha. Imana rero si yo itugerageresha gukora icaha , iyo umuntu aneshejwe n'izo nyosha mbi, aba asutswe n'ivyipfuzo vyiwe (Yakobo 1: 13) Imana rero siyo itugerageresha gukora icaha, iyo tugeragejwe tukagwa mu caha tuba dusutswe n'ivyipfuzo twipfuza nico gituma handitswe ngo (Yakobo 1:15). Umuntu akora icaha aba ariko arikwegera urupfu.Icaha rero kidutandukanya n'Imana.
name: Ivyo kugeragezwa no gukora icaha

description: Ikiganiro giheruka, cari gishimikiye kuvyo kwirinda ngo ntitukarobanure abantu k'ubutoni. Twarumvise yuko Imana idahimbagwa nukubona abantu bacinyizwa kubera ko ari aboro. Mw'isi yose usanga abantu bato bato bafashwe nabi hagashirwa hejuru abatunzi n'abategetsi igitangaje kandi nuko usanga akarenganyo karashitse no mw'ishengero ry'abizera Umwami Yesu. Imana iragomba ko tumenya ko umutunzi atariwe ahiriwe,ubutunzi bwiwe ni ubw'igihe gito kuko ari ubwo mw'isi . Ni vyiza kandi kumenya yuko aboro bashobora kubamwo ubutunzi buhambaye muvyo kumenya Imana.
name: Ivyo kurobanura ku cubahiro

description: Mu kiganiro giheruka twabonye mu gice ca 4, ivy'ukugwanya satani , ukwicisha bugufi hamwe n'ukwirinda gufata imigambi ya kazoza hatarimwo Imana.
name: Kugwanya Satani no kwiyegurira Imana

description: Twaronse inyigisho zijanye nokwirinda ngo ntiducudike n'isi nk'uko tubibona Yakobo 4:4 havuga ngo : Yemwe basambanyi ntimuzi yuko gucudika n'isi ari ukwankana n'Imana. Nuko umuntu wese agomba kuba incuti y'isi aba yigize umwansi w'Imana.Iyo tugomvye rero kwifatanya n'ab'isi kugira ngo dushobore gushikira ivyo tugomba tuba tubaye abasambanyi. Kanatsinda twifadikanije n'ab'isi mu migambi yacu , tuba twemeye no gukoresha n'uburyo bakoresha mw'isi mukuyirangura. kuri bo rero kugunga, ukubesha no kwiba nibintu bisanzwe kandi biraborohera kubikora.
name: Kwirinda gucudika n'isi

description: Twihweje ivyo kwirinda kuvuga menshi, kwirinda kuraka nivyo kwiyambura ibitwandunza vyose bidutandukanya n'Imana . Twarabonye ijambo rikomeye (Yakobo 1:22) ngo :ariko mube abakora ivy'iryo jambo ntimube abaryumva gusa mwibesha. Ayo yose n'amajambo atubwira twebwe abamaze kwakira Umwami Yesu tukaba turi abana b'Imana , niyo atwigisha uburyo dukwiye gushira mu ngiro ijambo ry'Imana. Nayo abatarakira agakiza bo ntibabwigwa gushira mu ngiro ijambo ry'Imana , abo ubutumwa bwabo n'ukwizera iryo jambo bakaba abana b'Imana . Ntakindi Imana ibasaba kuyikorera ahubwo ibabwira ko hari ico yabakoreye kugira ngo bacizere. Abamaze kuba abana b'Imana rero nibo basabwa kuyikorera .
name: Kwiyegereza Imana no gukora ivyo igomba

description: Twaganiriye ku mahani yahawe abatunzi twishimikije ivyanditswe mu cete ca Yakobo 5:1-6. Muri iyo mirongo , Yakobo arereka abatunzi yuko itunga rikuru ari ukwubaha Imana. Nayo ahandi hoho ubutunzi butagiramwo kwubaha Imana buraboze. Kanatsinda bene bwo bitebe bitebuke bazobora nabwo buzotandukanywa nabo. Intumbero y'iki cigwa, n'ukugirango umu Kristo w'umutunzi yiyubare ntakoreshe kugunga abanyagihugu nkuko abanyepolitike n'abandi batunzi batazi Imana babigira. Vyongeye n'ukugira ngo umukristo yoye gukoresha nabi ubutunzi bwiwe yahawe n'Imana.
name: Yakobo ahana abatunzi
